title: Stress plan sheet
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y7 lesson 6 (Stress plan sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 6: Managing worries and stress. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Worry
Strategy
rows: List, break into steps, start with one
Calm down, talk honestly, ask an adult
Limit news, talk to family, make du'a

panels.title: When to get help
points: It stops you sleeping, eating or learning
Thoughts of harming yourself: tell someone today

frame.label: My signs of too much stress (body, thoughts, behaviour)
Three strategies that work for me
Who I will talk to (home, TGA, a helpline)

keywords.def: how the body and mind react to pressure
worry or fear that can feel strong
trusting Allah after doing our part (تَوَكُّل)

questions.q: Do box breathing together for one minute.
Choose a strategy for 'I'm worried about my first test'.
questions.a: Make a revision plan, sleep well, breathe, make du'a.

questions.q: Core: Make a personal stress plan (pupil PDF): my signs, three strategies, who I will talk to.
Extend: In the portal response box, explain how tawakkul helps with worry. Start: 'Tawakkul helps because...'
questions.a: Tawakkul helps because I do my part and then trust Allah with the result, so I worry less about what I cannot control.

questions.q: Best first step when homework feels overwhelming?
options: Break it into small steps and start one
questions.a: B) Break it into small steps and start one. Small steps make the task manageable.

questions.q: A little stress can... A) always harm B) help us focus C) never happen
Big question: when should stress make you ask for help?
questions.a: When it lasts, stops sleeping or learning, or you feel unsafe.
